errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.panelHelp: The rest of the screen and your current trials are intact. Try again; if it persists, reload the page.

targets.title: Targets & measurement setup
targets.description: Grouped per station, like the blocks of a STAR*NET data file, references first. The table states; you edit a selection, or one sight in the panel on the right.
targets.noMatch: No target matches the current filters.
targets.noConstant: A reflectorless measurement has no prism constant.
targets.legend: Grey σ = the instrument value (Instruments step); magenta σ = a value of this sight only. "BTM +x" = the constant BTM applies; "applied" = a constant already applied in the field, never applied twice. The E N H tokens are the datum: E! = fixed, E followed by a number = constrained at that σ in mm, greyed E = free. Two constrained or fixed points are enough for the computation to converge.
targets.coordinateApproximate: Coordinate computed at initialisation, not supplied by the survey. The constraint is valid and counts towards the datum.
targets.constraintNonReference: Constraining a monitored point is allowed: two constrained or fixed points are enough to give the network a datum, whatever their role.
targets.bulkHint: A field left empty is not applied.
targets.bulkConstraint: Constraint on E, N and H
targets.emptyFollowsInstrument: An empty field follows the instrument: the greyed value is the one that will be used.
targets.noCoordinateYet: No coordinate yet — run the Initialisation step: it is where the coordinates of every point come from.

initialisation.title: Initialisation
initialisation.description: Obtain the network's approximate coordinates. Fixing a station here is a computation device: what a run holds fixed is decided in the Adjustment step.
initialisation.modeKnown: Compute from the known reference coordinates (recommended)
initialisation.modeEntered: Type in or import the initial coordinates
initialisation.modeLocal: Fix one station in XYZ and orientation
initialisation.knownHelp: Only coordinates genuinely provided with the dataset are offered. The standard errors are the survey's: they say how well the reference is known.
initialisation.enteredHelp: Entered coordinates are approximations, with no standard error: they position the network and the stations are resected from them.
initialisation.localHelp: One station is held in XYZ and orientation to radiate the network and obtain the approximate coordinates. Its position may be the real georeferenced one or an arbitrary origin — 0/0/0/0 is valid. Either way the station is free again in the runs.
initialisation.zeroIsValid: 0/0/0/0 is valid — an arbitrary origin is a datum like any other
initialisation.badRange: Choose two existing cycles in chronological order.
initialisation.windowNote: This period selects the observations used to estimate the approximate coordinates. It describes the data used, not the validity of the configuration.

gate.initialisation-not-accepted: Compute and accept the approximate coordinates before continuing.
gate.no-datum: No point is constrained or fixed: the computation cannot converge.
gate.not-enough-references: Fewer than {{minimum}} constrained or fixed points: the system is rank deficient, a run would publish nothing and the cycle would be skipped.

adjustment.title: Adjustment
adjustment.description: The parameters and the datum that every run of this version will use.
adjustment.weightsProposal: FR weights and centrings are editable Topcon proposals, not a national standard. Review them before activation.
adjustment.weightsAccept: I reviewed and accept these weights for this configuration version
adjustment.convergeHelp: STAR*NET threshold — not the demo solver's (ADJ-002)
adjustment.chiFail: Fail run and do not publish
adjustment.scaleNote: .SCALE is a horizontal datum factor and the refraction coefficient corrects zenith geometry — neither replaces the EDM T/P correction (CORR-007/008).
adjustment.testDescription: The same gesture as the Analysis Lab bench: one epoch, one engine, one button. Nothing is published.
adjustment.noSlot: No output slot is available. Select at least one station with observations.
adjustment.filesHint: The exact files handed to the engine for this epoch.
adjustment.sigmaDescription: What actually weights each observation, per station and per reflector. The same values as the Instruments step: editing them here edits them there.
adjustment.projectDefaultsNote: These are the project defaults written into the .prj. The observations themselves carry the precision resolved above.
adjustment.trialsDescription: Change, recompute, compare — the Analysis Lab gesture. Each trial keeps the configuration that produced it: "Restore" brings it back verbatim.

failureSource.service: Reported by the Windows service itself.
failureSource.listing: Quoted from the .lst listing STAR*NET produced.

adjustment.failureSilent: STAR*NET did not complete but produced no quotable message. The full listing and console are in the files below.
adjustment.failureHint: STAR*NET text, quoted as-is. The generated files below carry the full listing.
adjustment.starnetIsTheAnswer: These figures come from STAR*NET's own listing. The preview solver is not consulted for a licensed run, and its numbers are not shown here.
adjustment.starnetRunning: Submitted to the service — nothing is published until STAR*NET answers.

datum.title: 1 · Network datum
datum.stationHeldNote: A constrained station is unusual in monitoring: it carries the instrument, and is normally left free once the initial coordinates are computed.
datum.summaryDescription: What STAR*NET will write in its C records. Constraints are decided in Targets & Measurements, on the prisms themselves; this screen gives the verdict before a trial is launched.
datum.notSolvable: {{count}} constrained or fixed point out of a minimum of {{minimum}}: the computation cannot converge on a unique answer. Below two points an infinity of translated and rotated solutions fits the measurements equally well — the system is rank deficient. Constrain at least two targets in Targets & Measurements.
datum.computedCoordinates: Constraint placed on coordinates computed at initialisation rather than supplied by the survey: {{points}}. The datum is then local — the network cannot detect a movement of the whole, only relative movements.
datum.overrideNote: A value entered here replaces the one the initialisation computed, for this point, until it is reset.
datum.frameShift: The frame has moved since {{count}} constraint(s) were placed: {{points}}. Recomputing the initialisation moved the approximations, so those points now hold the network somewhere other than what was on screen when the decision was taken. Check that this is intended.

precision.title: Measurement precision
precision.restoreHint: Click the badge to go back to the template values.
precision.notSighted: No sight of this station uses a reflector yet: the list appears after the Targets & measurements step.
precision.sharedPrecision: These reflectors share one precision: an EDM has one with a reflector and another without.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: What each station brings: the instrument height, the atmospheric correction, and how well it measures. The reflector and its constant stay resolved per station × target in the next step.
instruments.envMapped: BTM raw_data mapping: temperature variable {{temperature}} · pressure variable {{pressure}}. Values are resolved for each station cycle.
instruments.envMissing: No mapped temperature/pressure variables are available for this station; the missing-data policy will apply.
instruments.tpTolerance: A temperature/pressure reading serves an observation when it is within {{minutes}} min of that observation — of the observation itself, not of the publication slot.

formula.noneApplied: The distance receives the reflector constant only, with no atmospheric factor.
formula.alreadyApplied: The station delivers distances it has already corrected for the atmosphere: BTM does not apply it a second time (CORR-005).
formula.none: This mode declares the atmospheric correction negligible for this site — which is not the same as ignoring it for want of T/P.
formula.units: P in hectopascals, T in degrees Celsius. Applied after the reflector constant (CORR-004), and never written into STAR*NET .SCALE, which is a datum/grid factor (CORR-007).
formula.withReference: Worked on a reference atmosphere (this station resolves T/P per cycle)
formula.mismatch: The template declares {{declared}} v{{declaredVersion}}, but this mode applies {{applied}}. The formula above is the one that will weigh the distances.
formula.legendSd: slope distance as stored in BTM
formula.legendDelta: reflector constant: the one required minus the one already applied in the field
formula.legendPpm: parts per million derived from temperature and pressure
formula.order: Order of application: the reflector constant first, the atmosphere second (CORR-004). Each correction is applied exactly once and traced.

output.variablesNote: Stations are included: a station is free during the adjustment, so its position moves from one run to the next like a prism’s. Delta = adjusted − the initial coordinate produced by the Initialisation step, which is what every future run will compare against.
output.noTrialYet: Run Test one epoch at the Adjustment step to see the variables with the values of the cycle this adjustment is built on.

direction.above: Measurements disagree more than the declared precision allows
direction.below: The adjustment fits better than the declared precision

explain.above: Look for a blunder, a moved reference or an omitted correction before touching weights.
explain.below: The stated sigmas are pessimistic for this data. Nothing indicates a measurement problem.
explain.within: The residuals match the precision you declared.

warning.inflatedSigmas: Sigmas were multiplied, which makes any test easier to pass.
warning.manyExclusions: More than a tenth of the measurement components are excluded.
warning.freedReferences: References were freed, so the datum changed.
warning.lowRedundancy: Almost no redundancy: the geometry cannot check itself.
warning.fitsBetterThanDeclared: The fit is better than declared precision, so the test proves little.

validation.title: Validation catalogue
validation.subtitle: 100 generated networks with a known truth, for demonstration, regression testing and blind practice.
validation.classification: Synthetic truth-first data — not field measurements.
validation.loadedShards: Loaded on demand: {{count}} of {{total}} data files
validation.canonicalHint: BTM-VAL-041 is the reference clean network.

blind.label: Blind mode
blind.help: Blind mode hides the expected scenario and the injected fault so a dataset can be diagnosed rather than looked up.
blind.revealWarning: This shows the generated truth. Use it for acceptance testing, not while practising.

import.title: Open {{id}} in the Analysis Lab
import.description: The dataset becomes a real processing: configuration version, epochs, runs and trials all behave as usual. Nothing is written back to the generated files.
import.faceReductionMean: Average Face I and Face II
import.faceReductionHelp: This dataset contains Face II readings. Averaging the pair cancels collimation and vertical index errors; keeping Face I alone reproduces acquisition that never reduced them.
import.replaceWarning: This dataset is already open as a lab session. Importing again replaces it.

identity.homonymsHelp: These stay separate. They are never linked automatically.

analysis.subtitle: Understand why an adjustment succeeds or fails, try a traceable correction, then save what works.
analysis.immutableNotice: Trials are temporary. Saving creates a new dated draft configuration; it never rewrites a used version or the source observations.

map.title: Network map
map.legend: Square: station · diamond: control point · circle: monitored point · magenta outline: shared physical point
map.exaggeration: Ellipses and adjustment corrections are exaggerated for readability.
map.noSolution: No solution yet, so the initial geometry is shown instead of an empty map.

selection.syncHint: Map, table and observations always show the selected trial.
selection.multiHint: Click to select · Ctrl+click to add or remove

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.controlHelp: Fixed: held · Weighted (σ): adjustable with weight · Free: no coordinate constraint
inspector.observationPrecisionHelp: Standard deviations for Hz, Vz and slope distance
inspector.singleRay: Controlled by a single ray: the geometry is weak even when the solver converges.
inspector.editedPending: Edited and not yet recalculated. Run a trial to see the effect.
inspector.rawDataUntouched: Edited values build a diagnostic trial only. The source observations are never modified.

points.title: Points
points.empty: No point matches the selected filters.

residuals.title: Residual diagnostics
residuals.search: Find an observation, station or target
residuals.stdErrHelp: Applied precision (StdErr): standard error assigned to the observation and used to calculate its weight.
residuals.stdResHelp: Standardised residual (StdRes): absolute residual divided by the applied precision (StdErr). The review level is based on this value.
residuals.impactHelp: Potential share of an error transferred to the adjusted coordinates and orientations (100 × h). Calculated by the BTM mathematical engine.
residuals.empty: No residual matches the selected filters.
residuals.footer: Observations without redundancy, whose residual is fully absorbed by the solution, are not displayed. Distances and constraints are in mm; angles are in {{angleUnit}}. Residual, StdErr and StdRes come from STAR*NET for a licensed run. Impact is calculated by the BTM mathematical engine.

observations.title: Observations
observations.correctionBreakdown: reflector {{prism}} mm · atmosphere {{ppm}} ppm → {{total}} mm in total
observations.convertedFromHorizontal: horizontal distance stored, converted to a slope distance

trials.title: Trials
trials.stale: Parameters changed since this result was calculated. Run a new trial before reading or saving it.
trials.previewNotCertified: The preview engine is not certified. Production results come from STAR*NET Ultimate on Windows.
trials.upToDate: This result matches the current settings. Change a weight, a precision or an exclusion to run a new trial.

save.title: Save as a dated draft version
save.description: Creates one complete draft from the selected trial. The original version, historical runs and raw observations stay immutable.
save.action: Save calculated setup as draft version
save.blockedQuality: This trial cannot be saved: obtain a converged, full-rank solution whose chi-square is passed or legitimately not applicable.
save.blockedStale: Run a new trial before creating the version.
save.success: Created {{label}} as a draft valid from {{validFrom}}. Review and activate it from configuration versions.
save.freedReferences: This setup frees {{count}} reference(s). The draft preserves that datum change for explicit review before activation.
save.editedValuesIgnored: Edited Hz/Vz/Sd values are diagnostic only. They are never written to raw data or to the draft.

templates.title: Country templates
templates.description: A template pre-fills a processing; it is not a national standard and it never changes a configuration version that already exists. The two shipped templates belong to the repository and stay read-only: for values of your own, duplicate one.
templates.label: Label
templates.duplicateHint: The copy carries every decision of its source and becomes editable. A template used by a processing or a draft can no longer be deleted.
templates.systemOnlyHint: Only the shipped templates exist so far. Duplicate one to obtain an editable template.

field.refraction: Coefficient of refraction and Earth radius
field.reflectorsHint: A reflector is a reflector: only its constant changes. “No reflector” is the entry that carries none.
field.lastInstrument: A template keeps at least one instrument.
